items.claim: Untitled frames draw an empty heading or bar in rule, divider, notch, tab, titlebar, stereo and plaque
An untitled notch frame is named by its legend's controls
items.note: Its fieldset now gets `role="none"` when the frame has no title.

items.claim: `<DefaultMotif>` given a kind as `undefined` wipes out the outer default, and so does a `named` entry
sheet and well drop `inline` when the frame has no title
titlebar clips the focus ring of an `inline` control
items.note: Only the label clips and ellipsizes now; its test is a browser test.

items.claim: rule and divider treat `null`/`false` actions and leading as present, while sheet and well treat them as absent
items.note: One `drawn()` check now covers every part in every motif.

items.claim: rule draws its tint edge on the physical left

items.note: It resolves to `none` when no blur is set.

items.claim: `well({ label })` styles the titles of wells nested inside it
items.note: The selector now reaches only the well's own title.

items.claim: A stereo bar and its body inset part ways under RTL
items.note: I kept `side` physical, since it names edges (left, right, top, bottom): under `dir="rtl"` a left bar now stays on the left, beside its inset.

items.claim: `plaque({ mix })` outside 0–100 breaks the fill and ink
items.note: My call: a `mix` outside 0..100, or one that isn't a number, throws a `RangeError` rather than being clamped.
duplicate of A3, B2 (untitled heading) of A1, and B3 (inline dropped) of A4.
